description: This class serves as the main entry point for a Liquibase-related utility within the OpenMRS project. It manages file paths for XML changelogs, initializes tuner objects, and performs batch operations such as adding license headers and creating updated changelog files.

classes.name: Main
classes.description: Main class orchestrating Liquibase changelog file processing for OpenMRS, including license header management and changelog updates.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that triggers license header addition and changelog creation for core data and schema files.
